dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Although they all look about the same, some Fungi are friendly, while others are super aggressive and attack anyone they see.

dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: It can't be helped. Perhaps in their eyes, humans are like fierce "monsters" as well.

dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: After all, they can't distinguish which human behaviors are hostile or not, and it'd already be too late for them once humans have drawn their weapons.

dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: Hence why they tend to strike first, rather than waiting.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's not too different from how humans think sometimes...

dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: That's what I meant by shared emotions.
